fact: Werz hands over five unusual gems as a gesture of good faith for the assassin job.
source_quote: Werz handed over five unusual gems, suggesting they ask their gnomish companions why they were special
subject: Werz offers gems

fact: The five unusual gems are empty spell gems.
source_quote: he identified them as empty spell gems — the very kind used in the magical defenses of Blingdenstone
subject: five unusual gems

fact: Jimjar identifies the gems Werz gave as empty spell gems used in Blingdenstone's defenses.
source_quote: When Jimjar examined them back at Ghohlbrorn's Lair, he identified them as empty spell gems — the very kind used in the magical defenses of Blingdenstone.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Kazook Pickshine is a gnomish alchemist in Blingdenstone who would pay handsomely for the empty spell gems.
source_quote: He noted that a gnomish alchemist named Kazook Pickshine would pay handsomely for them
subject: Kazook Pickshine

fact: Jimjar notes that the gems are considered banal to anyone other than Kazook Pickshine.
source_quote: but that to anyone else they are "kind of banal gems."
subject: Jimjar

fact: It is unknown how Werz came to possess the empty spell gems.
source_quote: That raised the unsettling question of how Werz had come to possess them in the first place.
subject: Werz's possession of gems

fact: The party collects ordered magical equipment at Ghohlbrorn's Lair.
source_quote: Back at Ghohlbrorn's Lair, the party collected the magical equipment they had previously ordered
subject: Ghohlbrorn's Lair

fact: Zalthir receives two enchanted uncommon tattoos.
source_quote: two enchanted tattoos for Zalthir and a +1 longsword for Thorin
subject: two enchanted tattoos

fact: Thorin receives a +1 longsword.
source_quote: two enchanted tattoos for Zalthir and a +1 longsword for Thorin
subject: +1 longsword

fact: The party pays for the equipment at a 10% discount using pooled funds.
source_quote: paid for at a 10% discount out of pooled party funds
subject: equipment purchase

fact: Thorin's equipment cost came to 900 gold pieces.
source_quote: Thorin's cost came to 900 gold pieces, pooled from party funds that included 616 gp on hand, the recent 275 gp advance, and some platinum.
subject: Thorin's cost

fact: Jimjar has heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and believes he is honest.
source_quote: Jimjar had heard Werz's name in Blingdenstone and thinks Werz is probably honest about being worth trading with.
subject: Werz

fact: Gyrgum believes the empty spell gems might be valuable to him as a cleric.
source_quote: Gyrgum, as a cleric, thinks they might be valuable to him depending on how they can be used.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Rumpadump is a myconid sprout that Zalthir saw looking unhappy near dancing myconids.
source_quote: Zalthir recalls an unhappy sprout he saw near a group of strangely dancing myconids; Stool recognises it as his friend Rumpadump
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Stool pleads with the party to save Rumpadump.
source_quote: Stool recognised it as his friend Rumpadump and pleaded with the party to drop everything and save him.
subject: Stool

fact: The party agrees to look for Rumpadump on their way to deal with the assassins.
source_quote: Gyrgum wanted to deal with the assassins first; since Rumpadump lay on the way, the group agreed to make the detour
subject: detour agreement

fact: Gyrgum wants to deal with the assassins before rescuing Rumpadump.
source_quote: Gyrgum wanted to deal with the assassins first
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Zalthir recalls seeing Rumpadump looking depressed.
source_quote: Zalthir notes Rumpadump looked depressed, "but the other ones were shaking or dancing and looked concerning."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Stool states that myconids do not attack people unnecessarily.
source_quote: Myconids don't attack people unnecessarily… But if you attack us, we attack back.
subject: Stool

fact: Stool describes Prince Derendil as very civilized.
source_quote: Stool contrasts the "very civilized" Prince Derendil with most quaggoths
subject: Prince Derendil

fact: Stool describes quaggoths as brutish and savage.
source_quote: which he calls brutish and savage
subject: quaggoths

fact: Stool claims quaggoths are bred to be violent.
source_quote: He argues, "It's in their nature to be violent. They are bred to be violent,"
subject: Stool

fact: Thorin criticizes the breeding of quaggoths as eugenics applied to sentient people.
source_quote: Thorin: "That's eugenics… But with sentient people, that's wrong."
subject: Thorin

fact: Daz compares the breeding of quaggoths to the cultivation of orange carrots.
source_quote: Daz: "It is how we ended up with orange carrots."
subject: Daz

fact: Stool asserts that everyone has a purpose in the circle.
source_quote: Stool: "Everyone has a purpose in the circle."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool states that if Rumpadump is worried, something is very worrisome.
source_quote: Stool: "If Rumpadump is worried, something is very worrisome."
subject: Stool

fact: Stool fears other members of his circle might be present near Rumpadump.
source_quote: He fears other members of his circle may be there too
subject: Stool

fact: Stool asks if the party can drop everything to find Rumpadump immediately.
source_quote: Can we drop everything and go find out right now?
subject: Stool

fact: Gyrgum suggests dealing with the assassins before rescuing Rumpadump.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "We're a lot of layers deep already… What if we do that after we discover the assassins?"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Zalthir reminds the group of the dangerous myconids and a scary ape creature near Rumpadump.
source_quote: Zalthir reminds the group there were a lot of myconids "and like the scary ape thing."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Stool promises that Rumpadump will ensure the party is not hurt.
source_quote: Stool: "I promise you, Rumpadump will make sure we don't get hurt."
subject: Stool

fact: The party sets its goal to get Werz removed from the assassins' list.
source_quote: the party sets its next goal: get Werz removed from the assassins' list.
subject: goal setting

fact: Thorin plans to tell the assassins that radical transparency would solve everything.
source_quote: Thorin plans to tell the assassins radical transparency would solve everything.
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum suggests the transparent solution is to threaten the assassins with death if they kill Werz.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Radically transparent would probably be: you don't kill him, or we'll kill you."
subject: Gyrgum
